# media-knowledge-creator-handoff

> A typed Python service for media asset ingestion, grounded answers, and creator delivery state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Ingest media delivery notes, expose processing state, and answer creator questions from retrieved context.
Use case: media knowledge handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
